Introduction
Inﬂammatory bowel disease (IBD) may cause signiﬁcant symptoms and morbidity if left untreated, including malnutrition in the
form of macro and micronutrient deﬁciencies. Current standard of care includes therapies designed to suppress the immune
response, with inherent risk of infection and undesired side effects. In addition, IBD is often diagnosed in childhood and early adult-
